title: Resolve FB-024 contract audit findings
summary: Resolved FB-024 contract audit findings by correcting subtitle drop-candidate facts and adding mutation-stage contract coverage for the disabled ingest exception.
reason: Worker findings FR-022 and FR-023 identified contract facts that were either implicit or misleading: ingest was the only mutation-capable stage without shared dry-run/execute intent, and subtitle builders left actionable subtitles marked as drop candidates.
behavior_before: Ingest was mutation-capable but used the bespoke copy_to_scratch intent without a test locking it to disabled entrypoint status. Source-media subtitle builders left text and image subtitles with the model default drop_candidate=true even when passthrough, convert, or burn actions were available.
behavior_after: Stage contract tests enforce ingest as the only disabled non-shared-intent mutation-stage exception. Subtitle builders now set drop_candidate only when no passthrough, convert, or burn action is available, with tests for text, image, ASS conversion, and unknown codecs.
tests_added: Stage mutation contract exception test for disabled ingest
manual_validation: Generated summary for MP-CHANGE-2026-0611-302 is covered by the packet
rollback_plan: Revert the source-media builder change and the added contract assertions, then refresh the affected summaries.
notes: Resolved FR-022 and FR-023 / FB-024. No FFmpeg or runtime media execution behavior changed.
